decisions.statement: A boundary with a date alone makes an all-day event.
An end is an all-day boundary where the start is an all-day boundary.
An end has a time where the start has a time.
An all-day event is given no zone.
A recurrence rule has no second `RRULE:` prefix.
A field Google sends that is not asked for is kept rather than dropped.

definition: how a calendar event is read off Google and written back to it
